correctness.rationale: The complete |3K| Wronskian for ten cubic sections has the characteristic-zero factor U² B(3A³+21962U⁷) with integer scalar c=27524002083766272000000=2^30·3^14·5^6·7^3. The asserted local leading-term and primitive-polynomial identity make c a unit for all primes p≥13; integral base change preserves the formula. Classical invariant relation B²=A³−1728U⁷ and tame PSL2(F7) quotient give branch orbits O24,O56,O84. The additional residual quotient fiber is unramified except if 21962=2·79·139 vanishes or if 21962+3·1728=27146=2·7²·277 vanishes, giving 2O24+O84+O168, 2O24+O84+3O56, or 2O24+3O84 respectively, all degree 300. Critical steps depend on classical invariant presentation and computed scalar; modular sample jet script is corroboration, not proof for all p.
